item.title: Ali Act Amendments Advance as Congress Details Changes to Boxing Regulation
item.description: Amendments to the Muhammad Ali American Boxing Revival Act (H.R. 4624) advanced this week after a bipartisan committee vote, according to a letter sent directly to World Boxing News from Congress. item.title: Zuffa Boxing 01 Results: Callum Walsh Overcomes Knockdown vs Carlos Ocampo
item.description: Zuffa Boxing staged its inaugural professional event on Friday night in Las Vegas, delivering an eight-fight card that produced decisive outcomes. Headlining the debut show, unbeaten middleweight Callum Walsh overcame a mid-fight setback to secure a unanimous decision over former world title challenger Carlos Ocampo, setting the tone for an event. item.title: Another Abel Mendoza Fight Missing From His 42-0 Record
item.description: Abel Mendoza’s unbeaten record is again being clouded by administrative inconsistencies after another professional bout failed to appear on the official register. For Mendoza, it is the latest chapter in a problem he says has followed him for years, with fights completed in the ring still not reflected publicly afterward. item.title: Julio Cesar Chavez Jr. Scores Stoppage Win in San Luis Potosí
item.description: Julio Cesar Chavez Jr. returned to the ring on Saturday night with a fourth-round stoppage win in San Luis Potosí, adding a needed result to a career that has recently been more about getting back to routine than making statements. item.description: Abel Mendoza is undefeated, active, and nine years into his professional career.
